findings.passage: I have worked to ensure that voter integrity is in place by passing a Voter ID law to ensure that only citizens that are eligible to vote may exercise that right. I assisted in passing a law that placed stringent requirements on the NC State Board of Elections to clean up the voter rolls and remove duplicate registrations as well as any deceased individuals.
findings.note: From his 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answers (campaign key messages). He describes the state photo ID law and voter-roll clean-up legislation as work he took part in.

findings.passage: Election integrity is a major concern. We must ensure that only citizens are allowed to vote in our elections. Voter I.D. and signature verification must be implemented to ensure that outside interference does not occur.

findings.passage: We must ensure that our elections are free and fair and that the electoral process is available to only our citizens through voter I.D. and signature verification on ballots without interference from outside entities.
findings.note: Same 2022 survey, answer on policy areas he cares about.

Ward is a co-sponsor of HB 825, Election Improvements (primary sponsor is another member; date is the bill's filing date, the date Ward was added is not shown). The filed text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H825v0.pdf) would change the absentee-ballot request form to require the last four digits of the Social Security number plus a driver license or special ID card number, and would change the alternative affidavit for a voter who cannot attach a copy of ID to a returned absentee ballot. It also bans ranked choice voting and shortens early voting.

findings.note: Co-sponsor of HB 958, Election Law Changes. The ratified text requires a county board to process a registration application only if it states the applicant is a U.S. citizen, with a sworn citizenship form if the answer is blank, and sets a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The bill page also shows a Governor's veto entry.

Primary sponsor of HB 1231, No Voter Registration Changes At DMV (filed 5/11/2026; sent to House Rules). It would require voters to make address, name or affiliation changes at county boards of elections instead of at DMV, and keeps the DMV question asking if the applicant is a U.S. citizen.

Ward is listed as a co-sponsor of HB 958, Election Law Changes (not primary sponsor). The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) adds G.S. 163-83, which says the county board shall process a voter registration application only if it affirmatively indicates the applicant is a US citizen, with a 30-day notice and a statement under penalty of perjury if the answer is blank. It also requires removal processes for voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, and monthly DMV-to-State-Board data sharing for voter-list upkeep. The bill page shows it ratified 2026-08-06 and vetoed by the Governor 2026-08-17.
